To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) teacher pay in a country is determined by a range of economic and social factors, (ii) the quality of teachers is higher where teachers are paid higher up in the income distribution, and (iii) pupil performance is better when teacher salaries are higher relative to other salaries in the economy.
Higher teacher pay in a country is associated with higher pupil performance, but the relationship is weak.
